findings.evidence: The item says the real translations are the τ-fixed skew-Hermitian bispinors and that Hermitian physical momenta are obtained by multiplying those generators by −i, but then identifies the same T_{α dotβ} with the Hermitian matrix σ^μ_{α dotβ}P_μ. At the stated nonzero rest momentum this makes T=−M I₂, which is Hermitian, contrary to the preceding skew-Hermitian condition. The algebra generator and represented Hermitian momentum need distinct symbols and a consistent factor in the mixed bracket. The assigned consumer reaches this batch-1 supplier through def-qftx-n1-chiral-superfield. Compare Martin, A Supersymmetry Primer v7, §3.1, equations (3.1.27) and (3.1.30), which distinguishes the spacetime momentum operator from the supercharge bracket: https://arxiv.org/pdf/hep-ph/9709356v7.
